# Town of Charlotte municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# held-straggler sweep; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Charlotte, Auditors meeting minutes, April 23, 2026 (draft): Richard Mintzer and Alexa Lewis sit as auditors alongside Patrice Machavern, whose April 13, 2026 appointment is already recorded. The auditors' minutes of January 22, 2026 style the trio 'Elected Auditors'; Mintzer and Lewis are therefore recorded as elected. Mintzer had planned to step down around August 31, 2026; no later record was found, so he is minted on the April record, disclosed on issue #163.
